text: まけた　ところ…　だれにも　みられて　ないよな？

structure.jp: だれにも　みられて　ないよな？

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.span: だれにも　みられて
patterns.explanation: This verb ending says the thing is done to the speaker, and に shows who does it. だれにも　みられて　ない = 'has not been seen by anyone'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている can say that something has happened and still stands. Here it is the shortened 'not' form, て　ない for て　いない. みられて　ない = 'has not been seen'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb put right in front of a thing describes that thing. With ところ it means the scene where it happened. まけた　ところ = 'the moment I lost'.
